text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'm observing the mock races. With 
the race about to start, tension fills the 
air when—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hmm-hmm... hmm...♪

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, look at the cotton candy... It's 
catching the wind and sparkling.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few sparrows are fluttering in the 
direction of Yamanin Zephyr's gaze, but...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Reading the air current's path, and 
surrendering to the wind at times. I was 
curious what that felt like.
choice_data_list:
It does feel like having total 
omnipotence.
It does look comfortable, at least.
It does look comfortable, at least.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I see... To weather any wind, one needs 
both speed and power, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mock Race Staff
text_block_list.text:
Post time is approaching! Please gather at 
the starting gate!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you're right. Thinking about it just 
made me start humming...

text_block_list.name: Mock Race Staff
text_block_list.text:
Post time is approaching! Please gather at 
the starting gate!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Well then, please excuse me, gentle 
breeze.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though the race was about to start, 
she casually made her way toward the gate 
at a leisurely pace.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The race has finally begun. Yamanin Zephyr 
appears to be in the middle of the pack, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(The wind... is blowing... It's 
different... from playing with Cotton 
Candy.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(A powerful wind... like a mountain gale. 
Constantly shifting, blowing free and 
unhindered...)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I want to become one too... A wind rushing 
through the boundless, endless skies――!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Competing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, Zephyr-san! First place! Was 
your calmness before the race part of the 
strategy, too...?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
No... that was merely entrusting myself to 
the wind. Like pure white silk carried by 
the breeze.

text_block_list.name: Competing Umamusume
text_block_list.text: U-Um? ...E-Err, meaning...?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Even the wind from a cotton candy's wings 
can become a mountain breeze. Which is to 
say, I caught that wind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A gentle breeze one moment, a raging gale 
the next. Running truly like the wind 
itself, she could pose a formidable threat 
to <chrname>.
